about_pullquote: I started this to be the electrician I'd have wanted to call myself.
about_para_1: Progressive Electrical Solutions was founded 15 years ago in Sheffield with a simple idea: be the electrician your mum would trust. We've grown from a one-man operation to a small, tight team, but we've never lost that principle. Every member is NICEIC certified, properly trained, and holds current Part P certification. We're proud that most of our work comes from repeat customers and their neighbours.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is honesty. We won't oversell you a new consumer unit when a single repair will do. We'll turn up on time, explain what we find in plain English, and quote upfront before we touch anything. Our emergency line is genuinely answered by a real electrician — not a call centre — and we aim to be with you in under an hour for any urgent fault in Sheffield.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done last summer and couldn't fault them. Started early, finished on time, explained everything clearly. House is a 1930s terrace and they sorted out all the dodgy old wiring. Worth every penny and they left the place spotless.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Called at 11:30pm on a Saturday because our kitchen had no power. They came out within 45 minutes, found a burnt socket, replaced it, and tested the whole circuit. Really friendly, fair price, and I slept soundly that night. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Rebecca H.

reviews.text: Got a quote for a new consumer unit from another firm for £800. Rang Progressive and they came same day, looked at it properly, and said the existing one just needed the main switch replacing. £120 all in. That's the kind of honest service you don't find often. Top blokes.
reviews.author: David P.
